themes.title: Far-right parties push 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying their focus on 'national priority' policies, particularly in healthcare and social services. This theme is evident in Spain, Italy, and France, where parties like Vox, Lega, and Rassemblement National are advocating for preferential treatment of citizens over immigrants and non-citizens in public services.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands exclusion of undocumented migrant children from early childhood services in Balearic Islands, citing a 2010 decree.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Proposes revoking citizenship and residency permits for foreigners committing serious crimes, framing it as a 'points system' for immigrants.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Criticized for policies that prioritize French citizens in social services, aligning with broader 'national priority' rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Opposes foreign flags on public buildings, reflecting a broader nationalist stance on cultural and institutional priorities.

themes.title: Car attack in Modena sparks immigration debate
themes.blurb: A car attack in Modena, Italy, has ignited a cross-national debate on immigration and integration policies. Far-right parties in Italy and other European countries are using the incident to push for stricter immigration controls and criticize current integration efforts.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Condemns the attack and calls for stricter immigration policies, including revoking residency permits for criminals.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Uses the incident to reinforce anti-immigration rhetoric and advocate for stricter border controls.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Highlights the attack to push for 'national priority' policies and stricter immigration enforcement.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: References the incident in broader discussions on immigration and national security.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Poland, Hungary, and Argentina are experiencing significant internal divisions. These conflicts are centered around leadership disputes, policy disagreements, and public scandals, which threaten the stability and unity of these parties.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Internal conflicts between factions led by Morawiecki and Kaczyński, with public disputes over leadership and policy direction.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Power struggles within the party following electoral losses, with factions criticizing each other's leadership and policies.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Internal conflicts within Javier Milei's government, including disputes over corruption allegations and policy decisions.

themes.title: Rise of far-right parties in European polls
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Germany, Sweden, and other European countries are gaining significant traction in recent polls. This trend reflects growing public dissatisfaction with mainstream parties and a shift towards nationalist and anti-immigration policies.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Leads polls in several German states, with record-high support reflecting public dissatisfaction with mainstream parties.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Gaining influence in Swedish politics, particularly in local elections, with a focus on immigration and national identity.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Increasing support in French polls, with nearly half of voters considering voting for the party in upcoming elections.
